gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve details of a specific authorized connect app using its ConnectAppSid so that I can manage its settings and permissions.
gold.ideal: The response should include the details of the authorized connect app, such as its name, description, and permissions granted.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to list all authorized connect apps associated with my Twilio account to review their access and ensure compliance with our security policies.
gold.ideal: The response should return a list of all authorized connect apps, including their names, ConnectAppSids, and the permissions they have.
